item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 09/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will bring one or two rain patches to Guangdong today. A relatively dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China tomorrow. The weather will improve and it will be cool in the morning over the region in the following couple of days.

Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
